  "course_description": "This course examines modern AI-native software development, where developers collaborate with increasingly capable coding agents. It covers how to define intent, provide effective context, structure development workflows, and coordinate AI tools. Students gain practical experience designing and evaluating agent-assisted software development processes. The course is designed for senior undergraduate students and addresses developer workspaces, agent orchestration, specification-driven development, loop engineering, software factories, and pipeline reliability. Students learn to configure AI-assisted coding tools and agent skills, construct executable specifications, analyze loop engineering workflows and coding agent outputs, evaluate automated testing and deployment pipelines, and assess AI-native software development processes.
